The checker rejected the program because the word "input" appeared in two comments ("input pair"). I reworded both comments and changed nothing else.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I1":     (110e-6, 60e-6, 250e-6),   # per-side diff-pair current
    "Ic":     (60e-6, 25e-6, 150e-6),    # cascode/output branch current
    "gmid1":  (13.0, 9.0, 18.0),         # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":     (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),         # diff pair L
    "gmid_s": (9.0, 6.0, 12.0),          # PMOS sources / NMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Ls":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),           # current-source L
    "gmid_c": (12.0, 9.0, 16.0),         # cascode gm/Id
    "Lc":     (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),          # cascode L
    "vds_src":(0.3, 0.2, 0.45),          # Vds reserved for current sources (sets bias R)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8; vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    I1, Ic = p["I1"], p["Ic"]; It = 2 * I1; Isrc = I1 + Ic; Ib = 10e-6
    gs, Ls, gc, Lc, vsrc = p["gmid_s"], p["Ls"], p["gmid_c"], p["Lc"], p["vds_src"]
    gb, Lb = 11.0, 0.5    # nmos bias mirror (tail family)

    # --- devices ---
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.25)
    mt = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, It, vds=max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.15))
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, iref, vds=0.65)              # ibias diode
    mbs = lut.size("n", gb, Lb, Ib, vds=0.6)                 # bias sinks
    mps = lut.size("p", gs, Ls, Isrc, vds=vsrc)              # PMOS sources
    mpd = lut.size("p", gs, Ls, Ib, vds=vsrc)                # pb reference
    mpc = lut.size("p", gc, Lc, Ic, vds=0.4, vsb=vsrc)       # PMOS cascodes
    mpcd = lut.size("p", gc, Lc, Ib, vds=0.4, vsb=vsrc)      # vcp diode / ref cascode
    mnm = lut.size("n", gs, Ls, Ic, vds=vsrc)                # NMOS mirror bottom
    mnc = lut.size("n", gc, Lc, Ic, vds=0.4, vsb=vsrc)       # NMOS cascodes
    mncd = lut.size("n", gc, Lc, Ib, vds=0.4, vsb=vsrc)      # vcn diode
    mpn = lut.size("p", gs, Ls, Ib, vds=0.8)                 # feeds vcn branch
    Rb = vsrc / Ib

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # reference and bias mirrors
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MBP", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbs)     # sinks pb reference
    n.dev("MBC", "vcp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbs)    # sinks vcp diode
    # pb reference (cascoded so source Vds matches main sources)
    n.dev("MPD", "d1", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("MPDC", "pb", "vcp", "d1", "vdd", mpcd)
    # vcp generator: R drop + PMOS diode at cascode current density
    n.R("RP", "vdd", "sp", Rb)
    n.dev("MPCD", "vcp", "vcp", "sp", "vdd", mpcd)
    # vcn generator
    n.dev("MPN", "vcn", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpn)
    n.dev("MNCD", "vcn", "vcn", "sn", "vss", mncd)
    n.R("RN", "sn", "vss", Rb)
    # differential pair (vinn drives output-side fold -> vinp non-inverting)
    n.dev("M1", "fa", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "fb", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # PMOS sources + cascodes
    n.dev("M3", "fa", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
    n.dev("M4", "fb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
    n.dev("M5", "xa", "vcp", "fa", "vdd", mpc)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "vcp", "fb", "vdd", mpc)
    # wide-swing cascoded NMOS mirror
    n.dev("M7", "xa", "vcn", "ya", "vss", mnc)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "vcn", "yb", "vss", mnc)
    n.dev("M9", "ya", "xa", "vss", "vss", mnm)
    n.dev("M10", "yb", "xa", "vss", "vss", mnm)

    # --- predictions ---
    gm1 = m1.gm
    r_up = (mpc.gm + mpc.gmbs) / mpc.gds / (mps.gds + m1.gds)
    r_dn = (mnc.gm + mnc.gmbs) / mnc.gds / mnm.gds
    Rout = 1.0 / (1.0 / r_up + 1.0 / r_dn)
    gain = gm1 * Rout
    cout = cl + mpc.cdd + mnc.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cfold = mps.cdd + m1.cdd + mpc.cgg
    p_fold = (mpc.gm + mpc.gmbs) / (2 * PI * cfold)
    cmir = 2 * mnm.cgg + mnc.cdd + mpc.cdd
    p_mir = mnm.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p_fold)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p_mir))
    itot = iref + It + 2 * Isrc + 3 * Ib
    power = vdd * itot
    swing = (vdd - 2 * vsrc) - (mpc.vdsat + mnc.vdsat)
    slew = min(It, Ic * 2) / cout
    return n, {"gain_db": db(gain), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "slew": slew}
```
